verifications.evidence: src/UI/ResponsiveTable.theme.test.tsx:160-233 adds a 'theme stylesheet' block that parses Theme.module.css. It asserts every colour variable has a light and a different dark value, and that dark defines no variable that light lacks (line 180). It checks every themed var() read by ResponsiveTable, LoadingSpinner and NoMoreDataMessage css is defined, and that the skeleton, spinner and detail-row variables exist in dark (line 192). It fails if a hard-coded hex or rgb colour remains outside var() fallbacks, shadows and keyframes (line 206). It checks the wrapper is display: contents and declares no variables (line 217). It checks light and dark variable blocks sit only on zero-specificity :where(:root) and :where(.themeDark), and that the wrapper sets no inline --table-header-bg (line 223), so an app override of --table-header-bg is not shadowed. Each of these would fail if the dark values were missing or identical to light, a light colour stayed hard-coded, or the override stopped applying. The developer reports a full suite pass (12 suites, 95 tests); I did not rerun it.
